notes: The red envelope on the path is a little 3D envelope in one of three looks (plum blossom, golden clouds, jade clasp). Finishing the lesson before it ends with Open your red envelope: back on the path it jumps awake, spins and shakes. Tap it and it flies to the middle of the screen, shakes harder and harder, then bursts open with a flash, spinning light and sparks, and its coins fly out at you while the count climbs. Collect closes it
